test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
The given bar graph reflects the data on the favourite colours of several students in a class. Suppose the students are divided into two groups, A and B, with those in Group A choosing one of Red, Green, Orange or Pink as their favourite colour and those in Group B choosing any of the other four colours as the favourite. How many more students were there in Group A than in Group B as per the bar graph?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0980ce04d829e226e69f1c471257f3f86194f7031e9bfb2b821efa8db2dcad74.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Colour is chosen by group A = Red + Green + Orange + Pink

⇒ 10 + 6 + 4 + 7 = 27

Colour is chosen by group B = Blue + Yellow + Black + White

⇒ 7 + 7 + 5 + 6 = 25

Required difference = 27 - 25 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**
